name: shader_7cdfd9
vertexShader: varying float vL; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; void main(){ vL = uv.y; vec4 w = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.); vV = normalize(-w.xyz); vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * w; }
fragmentShader: uniform float uA; uniform vec3 uCol; varying float vL; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; void main(){ float rim = pow(abs(dot(vN, vV)), 1.6); float a = uA * rim * pow(vL, 1.4); gl_FragColor = vec4(uCol * a, 1.); }
